Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1450
Claimant:
Crystal Yang
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
February 11, 2025
Claim reported by phone. The claiamnt was driving a vehicle that struck another car while turning left at an
intersection. The policy driver is the claimant, and the policy is in force.
February 14, 2025
Spoke with the claimant, who is not represented by an attorney. The account of the turn and the impact was clear and
matched the first report.
February 15, 2025
Respnoding officer's report confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the scene. The other driver's statement agrees
on the left turn and the point of impact.
March 7, 2025
Photographs taken at the scene show damage to the front corner and driver side. Some details in the photos line up
with the claimant's description, though the photos do not show the full sequence of events.
April 22, 2025
No independent witnesses to the collision have come forward. The only accounts so far are the claimant's, the other
driver's, and the officer's observations at the scene.
May 9, 2025
Claimant reports neck and lower back pain following the impact and has beugn treatment. The reported injury is
consistent with a collision of this type.
June 8, 2025
Medical records received. Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for this kind of strain. No prior
injury to the same area appears in the records or in the claimant's history.
June 15, 2025
No earlier damage to the vehicle is on file. A neighbor mentioned seeing the car with damage some weeks before the
reported date, but has not provided details or a statement in writing.
June 30, 2025
Reviewed the damage estimate against the photos. It is not yet clear whether all of the listed damage resulted from
this impact or whether some of it was there before. Requested a repair inspection.
July 15, 2025
Claimant has repeated the same account of the collision in each conversation, including the timing, the direction of
travel, and the sequence of the turn.
September 7, 2025
File remains open pending the repair inspection, the complete medical records, and a decision on the neighbor's
information. Next review is scheduled once those items are in.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
